title: Every train in Bangkok in 24 hours
description:
Every train running in Bangkok on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside the Bangkok city limits. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: BTS, Blue Line, Purple Line, Pink Line, Yellow Line and Red/ARL, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 214 trains at 7:30 pm.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out King Bhumibol Memorial Day (October 13), Bangkok special holiday (October 16) and Chulalongkorn Day (October 23).
